title: Training
subtitle: Train your leaks and master the fundamentals.

newLeaks.desc: New tournaments reveal new leaks. Restart the loop: train → play → validate.

league.title: Training League
league.subtitle: This week's effort ranking. Practice counts, not skill.
league.empty: Nobody has trained this week yet. Be the first.
league.joinHint: Join the public ranking to show up here. While you're out, only you see your position.
league.effortNote: Ranked by correct answers in this week's training (effort), never by ELO. Resets every Monday.
league.effortSubtitle: Ranked by effort: correct training answers this week.

status.title: Your training
status.noSkills: You haven't trained any skill yet. Start a session below.
status.achievementsHint: Medals you earn by training, in any order, not a sequence.
status.reviewHint: Mastery dropped from lack of practice. Review to recover it.
status.selectHint: Tap a medal to see what it takes.

ghost.title: Ghost Table
ghost.desc: Drills focused on your highest-error spots. The SRS system schedules automatic reviews, reinforcing your costliest patterns before they surface in real play.
ghost.f1: Spots extracted automatically from your history
ghost.f3: 25 XP per completed drill, 100 XP on mastery

leakTrainer.title: Leak Trainer
leakTrainer.desc: Canonical GTO spots aimed exactly where you lose EV. No replay of your hand: each spot is a clean scenario from your leak category, graded instantly, and the next one adapts to how you do.
leakTrainer.f1: Curriculum built from your real leaks
leakTrainer.f2: Server-side grading against the GTO range, instantly
leakTrainer.f3: Adapts: miss a spot type, train more of it

summary.spreadDesc: This lesson covered {{count}} different situations, one or two answers each. Varying is deliberate: that is how learning transfers to the table. Mastery in each one rises slowly, with repetition across days.

academy.title: Academy
academy.f1: Intuitive math: pot odds, EV and equity
academy.f4: XP and streak for every correct exercise

trainer.title: Leak training
trainer.subtitle: Close your leaks two complementary ways.

review.title: Review
review.desc: Real hands from your history, spaced repetition.

train.title: Train
train.desc: Synthetic spots tuned to your leaks.

trainer.hint: Review locks in what you got wrong. Train builds the pattern. Together they close the leak.

journey.title: Your journey

train.title: Train
train.tip: Train your failure points with GTO drills until you master each one. It's the practice axis: it earns XP, mastery and achievements, but does NOT touch your ELO (which comes only from real hands).

apply.title: Play
apply.tip: When you're ready, play a real tournament focusing on what you trained and import the hands. This is where practice turns into real play.

prove.title: Validate
prove.tip: The platform compares your real metrics before and after training, to show whether the improvement showed up in your actual game.

journey.beginnerHint: Play and import your first tournaments ({{done}}/{{target}}) so the platform can measure your real failure points. Meanwhile, train the fundamentals.
journey.gateHintProtocol: The five mastery criteria. Complete them and the next leak unlocks.
journey.allMasteredMsg: You mastered {{count}} leak(s) in training. Now play: the proven seal depends on your next tournaments.
journey.noLeakYet: No measured leak to train yet. Import tournaments so the diagnosis can find the first one.
journey.lockNote: You can play and import any time. The lock only marks where your STUDY should be right now.

proof.title: Validate learning
proof.subtitle: Your REAL error rate in this spot (from your hands, not the drills), before training vs after you played and imported.
proof.disclaimer: The verdict only lands when the difference survives the confidence interval, and the "before" is corrected so improvement is not inflated. Bubble and final table situations stay out of the count. It is a comparison between two periods, not proof the training caused the change.
proof.needHands: {{n}} more decisions in this spot across your tournaments before there is a verdict.
proof.needBaseline: Not enough history before training to compare against.
proof.reopened: A leak came back in your play and was reopened for training.
proof.reopened_plural: {{count}} leaks came back in your play and were reopened for training.

challenge.title: Daily Challenge
challenge.subtitle: A spot on the edge of the decision. Pick the best play, you get one try per day.
challenge.comeBack: Come back tomorrow for a new challenge.

grind.name: Full hand
grind.desc: Walk a real hand from preflop to river, deciding on every street.

grind.title: The whole hand
grind.subtitle: A real hand, decision by decision, preflop to river.
grind.noVerdict: This spot has no reference answer, so it does not count.
grind.skipped: {{n}} decision was left out of the score for lack of a reference answer.
grind.disclaimer: This hand really happened and is anonymized: you see position and stack, never who played it. The board and the villain's cards are already decided — you answer what GTO would do, and the hand follows the path it took.
